paper_metadata.title: Microstructure and strength of quasicrystal containing extruded Mg–Zn–Y alloys for elevated temperature application

evidence.quote: Microstructural studies have been made on alloys Mg95Zn4.2Y0.8 and Mg92.5Zn6.5Y containing icosahedral quasicrystalline phase extruded at two different temperatures of 523 K and 673 K and correlated to room temperature and higher temperature tensile strength.

Microstructure of two alloys Mg95Zn4.2Y0.8 (Alloy 1) and Mg92.5Zn6.5Y (Alloy 2) with different zinc and yttrium content have been studied after extrusion at two different temperatures of 523 K and 673 K and after heat treatment.

Good mechanical strength at room temperature is achieved due to nano-precipitation of the icosahedral phase upon post-extrusion heat treatment (YS 240 MPa UTS 300 MPa, elongation ∼20% in Alloy 2, grain size >2 0 /H9262m).
